assertion.statement: The all-graph universal correction is independent of the arithmetic Frobenius lift and graph orientation, and its local two-place determinant has residual t-order exactly four at augmentation.
assertion.objects: The graph-wide actual finite moving characters, local scalar z_q, inertia generator g_q, e_q, l_q and correction1+(1+g_q)v_q in O[G].
assertion.hypotheses: The full graph prescription and compatible Kummer/ring-class realization are supplied; the universal group ring is two-torsion-free and e_q is a unit after inner limit/localization.
assertion.quantifiers: Every graph prime q, including those unused by a constituent and those seen at augmentation, in each fixed finite binary family.
assertion.parameter_range: Good odd q and O[G] after the retained inner limit; finite character stages are handled before these inverses.
assertion.uniformity: Enlarging Q changes the finite realization field but not the fixed trace bound c_E.
assertion.constants: Modulo(2,I_G), e_q=t²/(1+t), l_q=t⁴/(1+t)²; augmentation determinant q⁴l_q has order four.
assertion.normalizations: Replacing Frobenius lift sends z_q to g_q z_q; quotient agreement gives(1+g_q)(vprime_q-v_q)=0 by two-torsion-freeness. Reversing orientation sends z_q to its inverse and preserves e_q,l_q.
assertion.exceptional_cases: An active ramified constituent is not assigned an unramified Frobenius eigenvalue. The finite characters need not be restrictions of one infinite Galois character.
assertion.limit_order: Prescribe all Q before moving-prime selection; realize finite characters and retain diagram limits; invert e_q only after localization; prove lift/orientation invariance before forming the finite product.
